verdict.rationale: Plaid IDV explicitly provides a Link-based drop-in flow (onSuccess/onEvent callbacks) that verifies documents, phone, DOB, and includes liveness/selfie matching against the ID, plus webhooks and Dashboard/API (retry, status) to read results server-side — all without building custom capture UI (Plaid's own hosted capture is built-in). missing for 10: explicit first-party walkthrough of the server-side 'create session' API call and hosted-redirect (non-Link) flow, and independent/hands-on developer confirmation of the integration experience.
